findings.highlight: Shirou when he dies easily from a simple mistake
findings.evidenceJa: 選択ミスでザッパリやられちゃった士郎
findings.governingReading: Shirou, who got cleanly cut down after the wrong choice
findings.explanation: The English turns the vivid manner of defeat into an evaluation that Shirou died easily.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーちゃんの猪突猛進なところ
findings.governingReading: Saber’s tendency to charge straight ahead like a boar
findings.explanation: Recklessness removes the concrete headlong-charge image from Taiga’s tactical advice.

findings.governingReading: proof that Saber let her guard or tension lapse
findings.explanation: Not concentrating recasts a lapse in vigilance as generic attention failure.

findings.highlight: Bushido is all about sympathy and no love
findings.evidenceJa: ブシドーは色無し恋無し情け有り
findings.governingReading: Bushido has no sensuality, no romance, but does have compassion.
findings.explanation: The English collapses the three-part rhythmic joke into two terms and loses the 色／恋／情け progression.

findings.highlight: you do have to keep a leash on Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに首輪をつけなきゃいけない
findings.governingReading: you really do need to put a collar on Saber
findings.explanation: Leash replaces the humiliating collar image Illya applies directly to Saber.

findings.highlight: you mustn’t anger Saber-chan too much
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーちゃんを怒らせちゃだめ
findings.governingReading: you must not make Saber angry
findings.explanation: Too much implies that provoking Saber to a lesser degree is permitted, weakening Taiga’s categorical prohibition.

findings.highlight: She can get scary if she gets really pissed off.
findings.governingReading: When Saber is angry, she is frightening in earnest.
findings.explanation: Pissed off introduces profanity and attaches intensity to Saber’s anger rather than to how frightening she becomes.

findings.highlight: Somebody almost died after making fun of her.
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっと前、セイバーちゃんをからかって臨死体験した子
findings.governingReading: Someone had a near-death experience a short while ago after teasing Saber.
findings.explanation: The English omits the recent timing and weakens the named near-death experience into almost dying.
